summary: `redemptions suggest` ranks your own redemption history by frequency/recency next to your balance -- it can never filter by afford-ability (Bonusly has no priced rewards-catalog endpoint) and reads the balance_history table, not the generic local-store path, when the live balance call fails.
reason: README Known Gaps #1 and the Redemption type's schema both confirm no priced-catalog data exists for a non-admin account -- a regen must not add afford-ability filtering without a new, live-verified catalog endpoint. Separately, "balance" is absent from knownSyncResourceNames()'s syncable list, so the generic --data-source=local path for it can never resolve; balance_history (written by `balance history`'s own RunE) is the only real local balance data available.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; an end-to-end run against a seeded local mirror confirmed the balance_history fallback and completed-state filtering both work.
